title: Toggle Group
api:
interface ToggleGroupItem {
  value: string
  label: string
  icon?: ReactNode
  disabled?: boolean
}

interface ToggleGroupProps {
  items: ToggleGroupItem[]
  type?: 'single' | 'multiple'
  value?: string[]
  defaultValue?: string[]
  onValueChange?: (value: string[]) => void
  preventEmpty?: boolean
  disabled?: boolean
  size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'
  /** Segmented options share equal columns and stay together; long labels can wrap. */
  layout?: 'wrap' | 'segmented'
  'aria-label'?: string
  'aria-labelledby'?: string
  className?: string
}

function ToggleGroup({
  items,
  type = 'single',
  value,
  defaultValue = [],
  onValueChange,
  preventEmpty = false,
  disabled,
  size = 'md',
  layout = 'wrap',
  'aria-label': ariaLabel,
  'aria-labelledby': labelledBy,
  className,
}: ToggleGroupProps);

props.name: layout
props.description: Segmented options share equal columns and stay together; long labels can wrap.

notes: layout="wrap" is the default for groups that may use multiple rows. Use layout="segmented" for equal-width choices that must stay together in one row.
In a narrow card, move the whole segmented group below neighboring content. Long labels can wrap inside each choice; keep a meaningful aria-label and the existing keyboard order.
